column1: # भित्ति-स्नैपशॉट् — the PROVED WALL list, companion to SetuSnapshot.tsv.
# A ford (सेतु) is a landed equivalence: it creates m×n free crossings between
# the components it joins.  A wall (भित्ति) is a proved ¬(A ≃ B): it creates
# none, and it retires a candidate merge PERMANENTLY.  Both are receipts in
# the same economy.  तपस् template-matches for fords and can never emit a
# wall, so nothing in the loop was producing this file.
# Why it must exist: read alone, SetuSnapshot cannot tell an UNMADE crossing
# from an IMPOSSIBLE one, so every pricing of the frontier over-counts.  The
# reachable ceiling is the sum over GENUINE equivalence classes of k(k−1)/2 —
# not the complete graph.  README.md:172 already says full connectivity is
# refuted forever; this is where that gets recorded per pair.
# A wall's identity is its DECLARATION, keyed like SetuSnapshot.
